claims.statement: The Apertus 1.5 report says images and audio enter the model as discrete tokens in the same sequence as text, and that the model understands those inputs but generates text only.

claims.statement: TII reports Falcon-ASR’s average Arabic word-error rate as 20.92% across six test sets, compared with 23.17% for the best published result in the leaderboard snapshot it used.

claims.statement: TII separately reports an internal Emirati evaluation, with 22.73% word error rate and the lowest word and character error rates among the systems it compared; this is not the public leaderboard result.
